decision: frozen before numeric sample extraction or model scoring
subject: JDS-SingleDay-JS14
selection_rule: Earliest complete W-track run with at least 40 trials, starting after trial 29. Earlier source exploration printed trial 0–3 data, isolated camera probes, and metadata for the first 30 trials.
withhold: No packets for the two embargo trials, five terminal reserve trials or any other run/animal. Read only interval metadata for partitioning. Binary-search timestamp probes and physical HDF5 block transfers can cross retained bounds; no held-out reserve trajectory or spike series assembled, scored or supplied.
selected_units: All 72 sorted units (file IDs 0–71) in the same immutable NWB, same W-track run throughout. One linked electrode row per unit; preserve both electrode table location and referenced group; no recording-availability interval or mask.
trial_boundary: Strictly inside original interval on the shared NWB seconds timebase. Preserve all original timestamps and XY values (incl. missing); no shared boundary sample/event, interpolation, velocity, smoothing, or trial labels supplied to the model.
forecast_scope: Nominal horizon +0.25 s; four 0.25 s bins of past spike events. Model owner separately freezes exact anchors, frame tolerance, eligibility, donors and training decisions before first score.
sampling: Tracked XY in cm relative to center well; nominal video 30 fps. Source preprocessing/visibility latency and ephys coverage/drift per unit are unverified. No image, limb, muscle, force, intervention or live control signals in the packet.
